entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac... I hope you can help me. I need to make a return for some cycling shoes I bought. I'm just so disappointed with them.
I'm certainly sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into the return options for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF75391. I've been a loyal customer for a long time and I saved up for these. They just... they're not right. They gave me terrible blisters after just one ride.
I see the order right here. Purchased about 23 days ago. I'm very sorry the fit wasn't right and that they caused you blisters. Let me just pull up the policy for you, one moment.
Please, I really hope you can process a return. With everything going on, I really needed this money back. It would be a huge help.
I understand. Okay, I've checked our policy, and you're in luck. All of our standard items, like these shoes, have a 90-day return window. You are well within that timeframe.
Oh, thank goodness! That's such a relief to hear.

Of course. I have just authorized the return in our system. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email we have on file. Just be sure to pack up the cycling shoes along with the cleats, and once our warehouse receives them, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method.
That's wonderful. Thank you so much, Isaac. You've really turned my day around.
I'm happy I could help. Is there anything else I can assist you with today regarding the refund or the return process?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
You're very welcome. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
